lines.text: &fAsk another player to let you teleport to them, or to come to you. Nothing happens until they say yes.
&7Pick a name on the left. &b→&7 asks to go to them; &b←&7 asks them to come to you.
&7They see the request in this tab and as a line in chat with the two answers on it.
&7A request lapses after &e2 minutes&7 if nobody answers.
&7Requests waiting on you are on the right. Accept starts a &a3 second countdown&7, then whoever is travelling arrives.
&7If the other player logs out or is gone by the time the countdown ends, nobody is moved.
&7The &fgear&7 at the top sets who may send you a request: anyone, your FTB party, your party and its allies, or no one.
&7A turned-away request is silent — the other player is told, you are not.
&7The two team settings need &fFTB Teams&7 on the server; without it they let nobody through.
